title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 12): POG in the streets, Pig in the sheets
summary: Part 12 of his mocking series on YouTuber Jason Blaha, focused on the 'fake merc' stolen-valor episode, alleged fake plates and height, gun persona and the fish-hook bar story. Mostly ridicule and allegations, with a few remarks on gun obsession as borrowed masculinity.
claims: He believes Blaha's colored plates are fake, citing Blaha's refusal to do a gym tour or show them up close
He retracts his earlier claim that Blaha is 5'7": viewers' calculations from camera footage put him at roughly 5'4"-5'5"
Blaha's claimed mercenary past was exposed as stolen valor, helped by Layne Norton paying to promote the article; NH argues the stories were lifted from movies like American Sniper
He says Blaha's posted shooting groupings showed he could not actually shoot
Men who can't summon masculinity in themselves try to borrow it through guns and fictitious badass personas
He mocks Blaha's fish-hook bar-fight story as a movie-style fabrication covering a black eye
Blaha bought a trap bar after watching American Sniper and abandoned it within about two weeks
He asks viewers to stop trying to identify and scare off his sources, which has already cost him contacts
